name: MJ Motorsports
old_description: Wow great place. Has all the latest aftermarket products. I came in with a stock Tacoma, he treated us with aloha and despite a line out the door, we never felt rushed. We purchased some blacked out badges for $75. We will be back for wheels and a rack! Thanks for the great customer service!!
about:
MJ Motorsports operates from Waipahu, Hawaii, as an online and brick-and-mortar retailer specializing in aftermarket accessories for Toyota trucks and SUVs. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed on the company's website.

The company stocks a range of bolt-on parts including LED lighting, wheels, off-road armor (bumpers, sliders, skid plates), interior and exterior accessories, camping and outdoor gear, suspension and performance components, detailing chemicals, and branded merchandise. Inventory is organized by vehicle generation, covering the third- and fourth-generation Tacoma (2016–present), fifth-generation 4Runner (2010–2022), and second- and third-generation Tundra (2007–present). The business functions as a reseller; no manufacturing, fabrication, or assembly operations are described on the site.

Customers are primarily Toyota enthusiasts building overland or daily-driver rigs. The site’s navigation and product listings target owners of the specific model generations listed above, with no indication of commercial, fleet, or OEM supply relationships.

Customer reviews posted on the homepage emphasize responsive service, an owner who is described as knowledgeable and personable, and a “treat you like family” atmosphere. The company itself does not publish a formal mission statement or list of competitive differentiators.
